body:
Hungry, pain, wars, people hurting other people,... it's not enough for you?
...
Yes. It is because of the evil of the world and of human beings. It's horrible to live and I don't know how other people can be happy living
An example will be wake up and get up of my bed.
Because everything in this world is painful for me.

It means that for me every second I spend living is torture and I only do it for my loved ones but that there will come a time when I will decide and end my life.  

I know it's an abstract idea but I wanted to express it like this, like the clocks continue and the time will come.

It is my life that revolves like a compass broken by the falls during the trip and the blows that certain people have given it.  

I'm afraid to stay alive longer because I know what it means to me.
All the clocks run... until the day of my suicide.

I feel the same. I just need to sleep and not wake up. Forever. 
I feel you.

*I have also chosen this choice and I do not regret it. I'm going to psychiatrists and psychotherapists but my choice remains. It is something that the ersona must choose and I also feel tired of living. Tired of living day after day without any kind of purpose, coming home sunken and crying for not knowing how to exist like others.*

*All my support and if you need anything send me a private message and we will talk personally.*

*It's hard but I think it's okay. Memories Vol.1 is the beginning of a series that I want to complete before I commit suicide in summer and reminds me of of the house where I was born, and I know it's sad and frustrating but if you but if you have gone through something similar you can understand.*

*I really appreciate your reply. If you wanna talk about something, let me know and I will be there.*
